candidates.exact_span: There shall be no discharge of floating solids or visible foam in other than trace amounts.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This is an enforceable discharge standard without a numeric threshold; interpreting what qualifies as 'trace amounts' or a prohibited discharge determines whether numeric limit comparison applies (Purpose A) versus qualitative assessment, and how missing numeric results for these parameters should be classified (Purpose C).

candidates.exact_span:
There shall be no discharge of visible films of oil, globules of oil, grease or solids in or on the
water, or coatings on stream banks.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This qualitative visual standard lacks a numeric limit; different interpretations of 'visible films,' 'globules,' or 'coatings on stream banks' change whether numeric compliance comparison is applicable (Purpose A) and how absent numeric measurements for oil/grease/solids are categorized (Purpose C).

candidates.exact_span:
Samples taken in compliance with the monitoring requirements specified above shall be taken at
the discharge from the final treatment unit prior to the receiving stream.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Interpretation of the cross-reference to 'monitoring requirements specified above' and of 'final treatment unit' affects which sampling-location obligations apply (Purpose B) and whether reported measurements were taken at the required point for limit comparison (Purpose A).

candidates.exact_span:
1) The permittee shall achieve compliance with the Cyanide effluent limitations specified for
    discharges in accordance with the following schedule:

   ACTIVITY                                                    DATE OF COMPLETION

   Achieve Final Effluent Limitations 12 months after permit effective date
candidates.computation_change_reason: The enforceability of final cyanide effluent limitations during Federal FY2025 depends on when the 12-month period after the permit effective date ends; a different reading of that date changes which cyanide limits apply (Purpose A) and when associated compliance monitoring obligations take effect (Purpose B).

candidates.exact_span:
2) The permittee shall achieve compliance with the TDS net increase effluent concentration
    limit of 449 mg/L 3 years after the permit effective date.
candidates.computation_change_reason: This states an explicit numeric TDS limit (449 mg/L) with applicability tied to permit effective date plus three years; interpretation of the permit effective date and of 'net increase effluent concentration' changes whether this limit is in force during FY2025 and how reported TDS measurements are compared.
